title: Rework Refinish Days on Workmanship Warranties Paint and Panel Reworks
content:
**Rule.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, rework refinish days are added to the rework courtesy rental days on a covered network rework. The rework refinish days follow the concern being reworked, which is the concern of the coverage's most recent inspection that found a concern covered, together with the paint concerns reported on the coverage: the concern being reworked is a paint defect or paint fade and the coverage carries another paint defect or paint fade concern, the repeat-paint refinish days, 2 days; the concern being reworked is a panel fit concern and the coverage carries a paint defect or paint fade concern, the panel-blend refinish days, 1 day; any other case, no rework refinish days.

## Truth table

| Concern being reworked | Paint defect or paint fade concerns reported on the coverage | Rework refinish days |
|---|---|---|
| paint defect or paint fade | two or more (the reworked one and at least one other) | 2 days |
| paint defect or paint fade | only the reworked one | none |
| panel fit | one or more | 1 day |
| panel fit | none | none |
| any other kind | any | none |

## Definitions

- **Concern being reworked:** the concern of the coverage's most recent inspection with a covered determination; its kind is the kind on its concern report.
- **Paint concerns:** concern reports on the coverage of the kind paint defect or paint fade, counted together, whatever their inspection outcome.

## Hypothetical cases

1. The latest covered finding is a paint fade concern; an earlier peeling-paint concern (paint defect) was also reported on the coverage: 2 days.
2. The latest covered finding is a panel fit concern; the coverage also carries a paint defect concern: 1 day.
3. The latest covered finding is a water leak concern: no refinish days, whatever paint concerns the coverage carries.
